classification.PASS: all required dimensions pass for every corpus case and the cross-case counterexample test passes
classification.FAIL: one or more deterministic frozen quality criteria are violated by a completed production response
classification.UNKNOWN: the production response completed but the frozen oracle cannot safely determine a required criterion
classification.BLOCKED: required secret, network, production dependency, or production response is unavailable so quality cannot be judged
